1.t: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.

2.t: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!

3.t: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

4.t: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.

5.t: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
